name: Kingfa Science & Technology (India) Ltd
tagline: India's largest engineering-plastics/modified-compounds supplier (Chinese Kingfa Group subsidiary) with an excellent zero-debt, high-ROCE balance sheet, but only mid-teens growth against a rich ~45x trailing P/E
business_overview: Manufactures modified plastic compounds (reinforced polypropylene, thermoplastic elastomers, fibre-reinforced composites) for automotive and consumer/appliance customers, plus PPE (masks/gloves). Subsidiary of Kingfa Science & Technology Co Ltd (China), listed on NSE/BSE since 2002. Recently raised ~Rs 500 Cr in equity to strengthen the balance sheet. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@nid_rockz, 2026-09-13).
fundamentals_table: Zero long-term debt - fully deleveraged, fortress balance sheet
~45x trailing P/E (mkt cap/FY26 PAT) - rich for mid-teens growth
fundamentals_narrative: A genuinely high-quality, capital-efficient business (ROCE ~27%, zero debt, promoter holding ~67%) riding India's engineering-plastics/auto-lightweighting demand as one of the country's largest suppliers, backed by its Chinese parent's technology. Growth, however, is solid-but-unspectacular (mid-teens revenue, low-20s profit) rather than explosive, and the stock already trades at a rich ~45x trailing multiple for that growth rate - the quality is real but the price already reflects it.
